mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing rizatriptan metabolism and increasing serotonergic activity, while both agents possess serotonergic properties increasing risk of serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity) and consider alternative triptan or antidepressant.
